jobs.description: Over de jobDo you enjoy working with your hands and are you looking for a nice job during the day from Monday to Friday? Then we have something great for you.  We are looking for a production worker for a growing organization in the production of hygiene products. The company develops and produces products that find their way to customers both domestically and internationally every day. Quality, innovation, and collaboration are at the core of this organization.  As a production worker in the mixing department, you will contribute to the production of hygiene products and cleaning wipes. You will be part of a close-knit team and play an important role in creating a safe and clean world.     What will you do?  As a production worker in our mixing department, you are a vital link in the production process. You ensure that our products are assembled with precision and care. You will work in a cohesive team where we support each other and prioritize safety and quality.  Your tasks will include:       - Gathering, weighing, and supplying ingredients     - Setting up the mixing tanks and monitoring the mixing process     - Producing end products according to recipes     - Identifying and resolving minor disruptions     - Performing logistics tasks such as moving and storing materials   Good to know: you will work exclusively day shifts with us, from Monday to Friday, from 08:00 to 16:30. This means you have your evenings and weekends free!  Do you speak fluent Polish, English, and Dutch? Then you may even be eligible for a managerial position! Wat verwachten wij?     - You have technical insight     - You take responsibility     - You preferably have experience in a similar role     - You speak fluent Polish     - You speak basic English and/or Dutch     - You hold a valid driver's license B  Wat bieden wij jouGood Salary:       - Gross per hour: € 15.87     - Net per week: € 450,00   The net weekly salary is after deductions for housing and health insurance.  Plus Extra
